purpose: Generate a native Rust forward Workflow orchestrator over checked Operation providers.
requirements: Materialize each step only from declared Workflow inputs and prior committed step results.
Await checked generated Operations through their explicit Store dependencies.
Stop at the first non-committed Operation outcome and preserve indeterminate commit status.
Expose needed-compensation recovery as typed inert plan data; never execute compensation automatically.
Return the declared owned Workflow result only after the complete ordered forward prefix commits.
